role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 每次施法都有机会获得数倍的效果，食人魔魔法师只要稍微走点运就能将敌人烧成灰烬，或者提升队友的力量。当然，有时候运气还是很难把握的……
hero_summary_en: With a chance to multiply the outcome of each spell they cast, a bit of luck is all Ogre Magi needs to burn enemies to cinder, or boost the power of his allies. Of course, luck can be difficult to rely upon...

abilities.name: ogre_magi_fireblast
abilities.description_zh: 以一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成伤害并使目标眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，两次火焰爆轰之间有%multicast_delay%秒的间隔。
notes_en: When Multicast, Fireblast hits the same target each time with a %multicast_delay% seconds interval.

scepter_loc.en: Fireblast is refined, reducing cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increasing cast speed by %bonus_cast_speed%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 很精通的火焰爆轰，冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒，施法速度提升%bonus_cast_speed%%%。

abilities.name: ogre_magi_ignite
abilities.description_zh: 使目标和另一个随机单位浸透在挥发性化学物质中，导致其瞬间被火焰吞噬。目标处在极度痛苦之中，受到伤害并且移动缓慢。
abilities.description_en: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.
notes_zh: 多重施法将使此技能有几率对%ignite_multicast_aoe%范围内的随机敌方单位进行多次施放。
引燃现在击中已受到作用的单位后会增加持续时间。
notes_en: Multicast makes this spell have a chance to cast multiple times at random enemy units in a %ignite_multicast_aoe% area of effect.
Ignite hitting an already affected unit adds to the burn duration.

abilities.name: ogre_magi_bloodlust
abilities.description_zh: 激起一个友方单位的狂暴，增加其移动和攻击速度。对食人魔魔法师自身施放时攻击速度加成更高。可以对防御塔施放。
abilities.description_en: Incites a frenzy in a friendly unit, increasing its movement speed and attack speed. Gives bonus attack speed if cast on Ogre himself. Can be cast on towers.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，%multicast_bloodlust_aoe%范围内的友方单位将随机获得嗜血术效果。
notes_en: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an %multicast_bloodlust_aoe% area of effect to receive Bloodlust.

abilities.name: ogre_magi_unrefined_fireblast
abilities.description_zh: 操控一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成%base_damage% + %str_multiplier%倍食人魔力量的伤害并使目标眩晕。魔法消耗为食人魔魔法师当前魔法的%scepter_mana%%%。
abilities.description_en: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing %base_damage% + %str_multiplier%x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is %scepter_mana%%% of Ogre Magi's current mana.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，两次火焰爆轰之间有%multicast_delay%秒的间隔。
notes_en: When Multicast, Unrefined Fireblast hits the same target each time with a %multicast_delay% seconds interval.

abilities.name: ogre_magi_smash
abilities.description_zh: 创造一个围绕友军目标的护盾，吸收接下来%attacks%次来自敌方英雄攻击的一定百分比伤害。吸收伤害后向攻击者发射火球。可以对防御塔施放。
abilities.description_en: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next %attacks% attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，%multicast_fireshield_aoe%范围内的友方单位将随机获得烈火护盾效果。
notes_en: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an %multicast_fireshield_aoe% area of effect to receive Fire Shield.

abilities.name: ogre_magi_dumb_luck
abilities.description_zh: 食人魔魔法师的智力值上限为0。他通过力量来获得魔法和魔法恢复。
abilities.description_en: Ogre Magi's max Intelligence is 0. He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.

abilities.name: ogre_magi_multicast
abilities.description_zh: 使食人魔魔法师在单次施法中有概率多次施放同一技能和物品。每%strength_for_one_pct%点力量提升%one_tooltip%%%多重施法几率。
abilities.description_en: Enables Ogre Magi to cast his abilities and items multiple times with each use. Each point of Strength adds to Multicast chance. Every %strength_for_one_pct% Strength adds %one_tooltip%%%.
notes_zh: 只有指向性技能和物品有几率触发多重施法。
指向性技能和物品额外对食人魔周围一定作用范围内敌人和中立生物生效。火焰爆轰和未精通的火焰爆轰将对同个目标生效多次。
notes_en: Only targeted abilities and items have a chance to be multicast.
Targeted abilities and items apply to additional enemies and neutrals in an AoE around Ogre. Fireblast and Unrefined Fireblast hit the same target multiple times.
facet_text_en: Each point of Ogre Magi's Strength adds %strength_mult%%% to Ogre Magi's Multicast chance.
facet_text_zh: 食人魔魔法师的每点力量值都会使多重施法的几率提升%strength_mult%%%。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_ogre_magi_dumb_luck_mana
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_mana_per_str}/{s:bonus_mana_regen_per_str} Dumb Luck Mana/Mana Regen Per Strength
